pixel_interpretation: RasterPixelIsPoint; sample coordinates from tiepoint and spacing
boundary_source: Official OneMap Male island GeoJSON fetched by parent agent
mask_method: point-in-polygon sample centres against OneMap polygon with holes; original 1arcsec grid retained; outside island set to -9999
limitations: Coverage and file integrity checked, not validated against local surveyed ground elevations.
30m ML-corrected global DEM does not resolve curbs, drains, buildings or street inundation depths.
Current island boundary may include reclamation absent from source-era elevation.
Elevation values are surface-estimate/corrected terrain estimates, not locally observed flood depths.

Within-island median5.04m and maximum15.15m raise concern about residual urban/elevation bias; do not interpret as validated bare-earth height. Zero-valued pixels may be ocean/water fills or reclamation mismatch, not proven sea-level ground.
